nl.title: Wat zit er in AEO/GEO/SEO pro (Enterprise) versus plus?
nl.excerpt: Wat zit er in AEO/GEO/SEO pro (Enterprise) versus plus: keuzehulp van TripleZero iT met criteria, trade-offs en wanneer welke optie past.
nl.bodyHtml:
In pakketten: basic (Business), plus (Extra Growth), pro (Enterprise). Pro is dieper/maatwerk dan plus.

Plus (Extra Growth)

  • Diepere AEO/GEO/SEO dan basic.
  • Meer ruimte voor groei naast 2 AI-agents.

Pro (Enterprise)

  • Hoogste diepgang en schaal (multi-merk/regio).
  • Maatwerkprioriteiten via Enterprise-contact.
  • Past bij complexe sites of zware concurrentie.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem of plan een afspraak. Vermeld je domein, doelen (AEO, GEO en/of SEO) en eventuele AI-scanresultaten.

Gerelateerd: Losse diensten vs pakket; prioriteiten bij alle scores laag.

en.title: What zit er in AEO/GEO/SEO pro (Enterprise) versus plus?
en.excerpt: Decision guide: inventory requirements, compare options on fixed criteria, record the decision.
en.bodyHtml:
“What zit er in AEO/GEO/SEO pro (Enterprise) versus plus” is not a panel-click procedure but a decision. Use hard criteria (traffic, root, budget, ops).

Preparation

  • Current workload (CPU/RAM/traffic)
  • Monthly budget
  • Whether you need root/SSH

Steps

  1. Write down: traffic, peaks, whether you need custom software/root, SLA expectation.
  2. Compare options (shared / VPS / dedicated / colocation) on: isolation, scale, price, ops effort.
  3. Match TripleZero iT plans or quotes against those criteria — not only lowest price.
  4. Pick one path; note migration work (DNS, mail, backups) if switching.
  5. Plan a 30-day review with metrics (CPU, storage, tickets).

Verify

  • Decision documented with criteria
  • Next migration/order step clear

Tip: Overprovisioning ‘to be safe’ costs monthly — measure first.

Note: Choosing on marketing claims without metrics leads to the wrong resize.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: VPS, dedicated, backups, support.
